cards.headline: Plant foot too far from the ball
cards.why: You planted about 38 cm from the ball (target under 26 cm). Reaching for the ball makes you lean back, which is why this shot would rise.
cards.fix: Land your plant foot level with the ball and a hand's width to its side.

cards.headline: Leaning back at contact
cards.why: Your chest was 16 degrees behind your hips when you struck the ball. Leaning back lifts the shot and costs accuracy.
cards.fix: Keep your chest over the ball and land on your kicking foot after the strike.
